shots.what: High crane down over the night crystal field: the great lantern waiting on its dais, its ready ring glowing; she walks in small toward it
shots.cue: bar 37 downbeat (THE HIT, t=86.4): the edit lands here from white
shots.note: Dark, quiet, nearly static; take the fade from white over its first frames. Heroine is small on purpose (scale shot), right of the dais. 18-frame handle (144-161).

shots.what: Profile from the west: she kneels at the dais foot with hands together, the fox above her, the lantern towering right under the Moon wheel; the fire takes and the light washes over the dais, a gold sigil turns over the sky
shots.note: Ignition (greatlantern:lit) at take frame 72.0 = beat 3 of bar 38 = section frame 216 (t=90.0); frames ~72-115 are near-white bloom, it clears to the sigil by ~120. Her skirt touches the bottom edge. Handle 144-161.

shots.what: TITLE PLATE: she rides the broom with the fox spirit across the face of the Moon wheel, camera flying with her below/behind looking up; nearly still, a slow push in
shots.cue: bar 39 downbeat (t=91.2), title 月帷巫女 over bars 39-40
shots.note: Safe title area: the upper 55 % of the frame, best centred slightly left (x 15-70 %, y 5-50 %): open night sky with soft violet rays. She sits at ~(37 %, 72 %), the wheel at ~(60 %, 72 %). A small sky rock enters the right edge only after take frame ~295 (in the handle) - do not slide this cut later than +6 frames.

shots.what: The lantern town in the lasting night from above, the camera craning up (37 -> 59 m) and turning slowly round the lamp tower: the lanterns of the plaza and streets come on ring by ring outward, then the tower answers and every street lantern string fades up; the town is at its brightest on bar 43 and the camera keeps a slow turn through the hold
shots.cue: bar 41 downbeat (last low drum, t=96.0); bars 41-42 caption, bar 43 (take 288-431) hold and fade to black
shots.note: Town dark at the cut. Lantern rings light at take f36, f72, f108, f144 (beats 2-5; each ring one by one, 3 frames apart; the stone lantern on the west road with ring 3); lamp-tower burst + all street strings fade up from f180 (beat 6), ~93 % by f288 = t 100.8 = the brightest picture; f288-431 is the hold to fade on (a slow turn, no stop). Caption 去把灯，一盏一盏点亮。: set it CENTRED like every other line, in the top band (y about 60-190 px): dark ground there, only the tower tip at the centre near y 200 late in the shot. 实机画面 bottom. No race ring (switched off), no trees except small tips in the top corners after f250. Handle 432-449.
